title: Contents Payment Settlement Worksheet — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
For the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own), a contents payment is issued on the policy's claim that carries its latest adjuster report, for that claim's date of loss, and the contents proofs of loss and contents payments for that date of loss include those filed under a duplicate claim number reported for the same date of loss.

**The payment.** The contents payment issued on a claim is worked out from the sworn contents amount, which is the amount sworn on the latest contents proof of loss for the date of loss; this policy carries the whole sworn contents amount alone, there is no other insurance on the contents, and the contents payments already made are the contents payments issued on the claim less the contents payment items voided on it. For a contents payment, and only for a contents payment, the payable amount is the part of the sworn contents amount this policy carries alone plus its share of the rest; a building payment follows the building payment rule, and every other coverage's new payment remains the payable amount less what has already been paid net of voids on that claim and coverage.

**Other-insurance condition.** Where flood insurance not issued under the National Flood Insurance Program covers the same contents, a contents payment follows the other-insurance condition that the General Property Form and the RCBAP both carry: this policy is primary, subject to its own deductible, up to the deductible of the other flood policy, and for the rest of the loss it pays the share that its contents limit bears to the sum of its contents limit and the other insurance on the contents; a policy written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program leaves this policy primary for the whole loss. The other flood policy's deductible is one layer for the date of loss over the property that policy insures; when it insures the building at the address as well as the contents, the layer is shared between the contents and the building in proportion to the amounts sworn for each, so the part of the sworn contents amount this policy carries alone is that layer multiplied by the sworn contents amount and divided by the sum of the sworn contents amount and the building amount sworn for the date of loss, never more than the sworn contents amount; when it insures no building there, the building amount sworn for the date of loss is nothing and the contents carry the whole layer.

**The BizFlood policy meant.** For a contents payment, the BizFlood policy meant is the named insured's BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) policy whose statement of values schedules the building's address, counted only when it was in force on the date of loss and is not written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program. That BizFlood policy is in force on the date of loss when the date of loss falls on or after its effective date, before its term end and before any cancellation effective date it carries. Its building value and contents value for the address are those its statement of values schedules. A contents payment is issued under this working only where the named insured's BizFlood statements of values schedule the building's address at most once and that BizFlood policy holds at most one value increase and at most one value decrease for the address; otherwise no contents payment is issued under it, the amount being nil, and the claim is referred to the adjuster to apportion the other insurance.

**Order.** The contents working applies its steps in this order: the part carried alone first, then the share of the rest, then the payments already made are subtracted; each step is rounded half-up to the cent, and the contents payment is issued only when positive.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Input | Figure |
|---|---|
| Latest contents proof of loss for the date of loss | 24,000.00 |
| Contents payments issued on the claim, less voided items | 9,000.00 |
| Part carried alone | 24,000.00 |
| Share of the rest | nothing remains |
| Contents payment | 15,000.00 |

With a hypothetical other policy's layer of 5,000.00 over the contents alone, other insurance on the contents of 60,000 and a contents limit of 100,000, a sworn contents amount of 24,500.00 and nothing paid: carried alone 5,000.00; the remaining 19,500.00 shared at 100,000 over 160,000 gives 12,187.50; payment 17,187.50.
